# directus_operation (Resource)

Manages a Directus flow operation (directus_operations).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `flow` (String) UUID of the flow this operation belongs to.
- `key` (String) Unique key of the operation within the flow.
- `type` (String) Operation type id (e.g. log, mail, request, condition).

### Optional

- `name` (String) Name of the operation.
- `options` (String) Operation-type-specific options as a JSON object.
- `position_x` (Number) Operation X position on the flow grid.
- `position_y` (Number) Operation Y position on the flow grid.
- `reject` (String) UUID of the operation to run on failure.
- `resolve` (String) UUID of the operation to run on success.

### Read-Only

- `date_created` (String) Timestamp when the operation was created.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned operation UUID.
- `user_created` (String) UUID of the user who created the operation.
